Demi Lovato Did Her Own Makeup for Date Night With Fiancé Max Ehrich
And she looked flawless.
By
Gianluca Russo
August 3, 2020
Neilson Barnard/Getty Images
If there's one thing that's still giving us joy weeks into this socially distant summer, it's
Demi Lovato
and her relationship with
fiancé Max Ehrich
.
On August 2,
Demi took to Instagram
to share pictures of the
newly-engaged couple
as they headed out on a date (wearing
face masks
as everyone should
on the way there
, of course). "Date night at Nobu. I love you @maxehrich," she captioned the pic of them standing in the restaurant, Max kissing her cheek. Both of the lovers looked stunning for the date; Max in a distressed Canadian tuxedo with reflective blue sneakers, and Demi in a velvet soft pink body con dress.
Instagram content
This content can also be viewed on the site it
originates
from.
On the makeup front, Demi chose a brown smokey eyeshadow look to pair with her dress and simple heels. She completed the eye look with a
thick black cat-eye
. Demi
sculpted her eyebrows to perfection
, also doing her typical face contour, and rounding off the look with some large
gold hoops
. And the star of the makeup look: Her lips, plump as could be
with the help of a little gloss
.
Screenshot/Instagram @ddlovato
Demi made it known on her Instagram stories that she accomplished this killer makeup look all by herself and if that's not inspiration enough to want to load up a NikkieTutorials video and start practicing, then we don't know what is! Grab your
best eyeliners
and
lipglosses
and get your Demi glam on!
Let us slide into your DMs.
Sign up for the
Teen Vogue
daily email
.
